{{Quote|Why us Brazzo? What have we done?''"<br />"''That black-hearted turncoat Vader! This is how he honors his deals!|Selle and Brazzo|<ref name="Vader's Quest 1" />}}
'''Brazzo''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] on [[Centares/Legends|Centares]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Selle! Noooo! What am I going to tell mother? What am I going to say?|Brazzo, after Selle's death|<ref name="Vader's Quest 1" />}}
He was known to have learned the identity of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. He and his sibling, [[Selle]], fled from [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], who eventually caught them. He fired his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] at Vader, who deflected the bolt with [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] into Selle. Overcome with grief, Brazzo failed to dodge Vader's killing stroke.
